research_areas: AI destekli bilgi yonetimi ve dokumantasyon

ideas.title: KnowledgeWeaver
ideas.one_liner: Sirket ici bilgiyi Slack, Drive ve e-postadan otomatik tarayip AI ile yapilandiran, kimsenin manuel dokumantasyon yapmasini gerektirmeyen akilli wiki

pain_evidence.quote: Notion consistently runs into the same ceiling as companies grow: it lacks robust document verification and maintenance features, doesn't provide adequate cross-platform search capabilities (it searches docs only, not Slack, Drive, or GitHub)
pain_evidence.source: Slite - The 10 Best Notion Alternatives 2026

pain_evidence.quote: Your team's abandoned pages sit in a graveyard of half-finished wikis. Knowledge lives in someone's head, not your workspace
pain_evidence.source: TaskRhino - Best Notion Alternatives 2026

ideas.competitor_gap: Hicbiri sirket icindeki mevcut bilgiyi (Slack konusmalari, Drive dosyalari, email) otomatik olarak kesfedip yapilandirmiyor. Hepsi manuel girdiye dayaniyor

ideas.title: QuickBase
ideas.one_liner: Hic kurulum gerektirmeyen, sektore ozel hazir sablonlarla gelen veritabani/wiki platformu - Notion'in esnekligi ama sifir bos sayfa sendromu

pain_evidence.quote: Notion requires upfront structure - you design templates, configure properties, build views - before you can start capturing information efficiently. Week one felt like configuring software rather than thinking
pain_evidence.source: The Modern Observer - Notion vs Obsidian vs Apple Notes 2026

pain_evidence.quote: People get overwhelmed with Notion initially which makes them quit
pain_evidence.source: Reddit r/Notion - This is for people frustrated with Notion

ideas.competitor_gap: Rakipler esneklik sunarken hicbiri 'hic kurulum yapmadan basla' deneyimi sunmuyor - ya bos sayfa (Notion) ya da cok kati yapi (Airtable)

ideas.title: StudyWise
ideas.one_liner: Ogrenciler ve surekli ogrenenler icin: ders kaydindan, PDF'ten, YouTube videosundan otomatik yapilandirilmis not, flashcards ve quiz cikaran AI calisma arkadasi

pain_evidence.quote: Where Notion requires manually building every structure and capturing every note by hand, Notelyn generates structured notes automatically from the content you encounter
pain_evidence.source: NoteLyn - Best Notion Alternative Apps in 2026

pain_evidence.quote: Record a live lecture on your phone and receive a full transcript, structured notes, and an AI summary within minutes
pain_evidence.source: NoteLyn - AI-powered Notion Alternative

ideas.competitor_gap: Mevcut AI not araclari ya sadece toplanti odakli (Fathom, Otter) ya da sadece ogrenci. StudyWise ogrenme odakli AI ile flashcards/quiz/summary entegrasyonunu tek urunde birlestirmiyor

ideas.title: ChatWiki
ideas.one_liner: Slack ve Teams'te calisan, sorulara dogal dille yanit veren AI wiki - kimse wiki aramaz, ama sormayi unutmaz

pain_evidence.quote: Instead of hoping employees search the wiki themselves, Siit's AI pulls the right documentation and delivers it in the flow of work
pain_evidence.source: Siit - The 12 Best Company Wiki Software Tools for 2026

pain_evidence.quote: The biggest challenge is keeping things organized without adding friction - especially when working in fast, iterative loops
pain_evidence.source: Reddit r/PKMS - What is your biggest problem with knowledge management

ideas.competitor_gap: Rakipler ya sadece Slack entegrasyonu (Siit) ya da sadece wiki (Guru). Ikisini de AI dogal dil sorgulamayla birlestiren ve kurulum gerektirmeyen oyuncu yok

ideas.title: ComplyDoc
ideas.one_liner: Regule sektorler icin (saglik, finans, hukuk) otomatik uyum dokumantasyonu, denetim izi ve imza akisi - Notion ve Confluence'in yapamadigi sey

pain_evidence.quote: A healthcare SaaS company needed to document SOPs, compliance policies, and audit trails for HIPAA certification. They were using Notion, but auditors wanted proof of page edit history, role-based permissions, and data residency guarantees. Notion couldn't provide those
pain_evidence.source: TaskRhino - 10 Best Notion Alternatives 2026

pain_evidence.quote: Enterprise teams often need more structure, security, and intelligence than Notion provides, specifically: permission-aware search, verifiable information with clear ownership
pain_evidence.source: Slite - The 10 Best Notion Alternatives 2026

ideas.competitor_gap: Confluence agir ve pahali, Document360/Helyjuice sadece KB. Regulasyon ozelinde (HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR) dogrulama akisi olan hafif oyuncu yok

ideas.title: SoloStack
ideas.one_liner: Freelancer'lar icin not + teklif + sozlesme + zaman takibi + faturalama - 5 ayri uygulama yerine 1 tane, hepsi birbirine bagli

pain_evidence.quote: A disconnected stack of 4-5 tools costs $30-60/month in subscriptions and hours of weekly admin to move data between systems. A connected platform costs $19-49/month and handles the data connections automatically
pain_evidence.source: Plutio - Project Management for Freelancers 2026

pain_evidence.quote: Most freelancers start with free tools and end up with a disconnected stack: Trello, Toggl, Gmail, Google Docs, and QuickBooks. Nothing connects
pain_evidence.source: Plutio - Freelancer 2026 Playbook

ideas.competitor_gap: Rakipler Proje yonetimi odakli ama saglam bir not/wiki katmani yok. Oysa freelance isin temelinde musteri notlari ve scope dokumantasyonu var

ideas.title: VoiceBase
ideas.one_liner: Sesle baslayan not alma: konus, AI yapilandirsin, etiketlesin, ilgili notlarla baglantilasin, organize etsin - sifre dokunmadan

pain_evidence.quote: Typing is so 2024: start with a voice note and let AI transcribe and organize your thoughts into a new note. Need to repurpose into a document? Don't do it by hand: ask Mem to transform it
pain_evidence.source: Mem AI - AI thought partner, Zapier 2026

pain_evidence.quote: I've been curious to try an AI notetaking tool that doesn't loudly announce itself when joining a call and only shares the notes afterwards with me
pain_evidence.source: Product Hunt user comment on AI note takers, 2026

ideas.competitor_gap: Mevcut sesli not araclari ya sadece transkripsiyon yapiyor ya da organize etmiyor. Ses girdisini otomatik yapilandiran, etiketleyen ve diger notlara baglayan yok

ideas.title: BoltBase
ideas.one_liner: Notion hizinda ama yerel-oncelikli, gercek zamanli ekip isbirligi olan blok tabanli not alma ve wiki platformu

pain_evidence.quote: Does anyone else find Notion painfully slow, or is it just me? Notion is almost unusable
pain_evidence.source: Reddit r/Notion - 2026

pain_evidence.quote: After 1 year only for me due to performance issues. Notion is just too slow when dealing
pain_evidence.source: Reddit r/Notion - Still using notion in 2026 or got any good alternative?

pain_evidence.quote: Collaborating with others requires some acrobatics. The easiest way is to create a vault, upload it to Google Drive, and share it with your team
pain_evidence.source: Zapier - The 9 best Notion alternatives in 2026 (on Obsidian's collaboration)

ideas.competitor_gap: Obsidian hizli ama takim calismasi zayif. Notion takim calismasi iyi ama yavas. Anytype henuz olgun degil. Yerel-hizli + takim calismasini birlestiren bosluk var ama daralıyor

ideas.title: MeetMind
ideas.one_liner: Toplanti notlarini otomatik ceken, ozetleyen, aksiyon maddelerini CRM ve task araclarina iten AI toplanti asistani

pain_evidence.quote: We built it because we were tired of leaving meetings with lost context, forgotten decisions, and action items scattered everywhere
pain_evidence.source: Spellar AI on Product Hunt - 2026 launch

pain_evidence.quote: I've been curious to try an AI notetaking tool that doesn't loudly announce itself when joining a call
pain_evidence.source: Product Hunt user review - 2026

ideas.competitor_gap: Yogun rekabet. Farklilasmak icin aksiyon maddelerini otomatik CRM'e (HubSpot, Salesforce) itme ve task tool'una (Linear, Asana) baglama gerek - cogu rakip sadece not/transkriptte kaliyor

ideas.title: Blend
ideas.one_liner: Muhendisler Markdown/Git'te yazar, teknik olmayan ekip uyeleri gorsel editorde duzenler - dokumantasyonu iki dunyaya da acan hibrit platform

pain_evidence.quote: Engineers want Markdown, pull requests, and repository workflows. Product managers and support teams want visual editing and collaborative writing tools. High-growth product teams rarely operate cleanly within either of these models
pain_evidence.source: GitBook - The 10 best software documentation tools in 2026

pain_evidence.quote: Tools that cannot support both workflows often create bottlenecks as documentation grows
pain_evidence.source: GitBook - 2026

ideas.competitor_gap: GitBook ikisini de dener ama aslinda developer dokumantasyonuna kayar. Notion Git destegi yok. Confluence ise agir ve modern degil. Gercek anlamda esit agirlikli hibrit yok
